decisive_items: a multiloculated complex pelvic mass with thick septations measuring 24 × 18 cm, likely arising from the left ovary
Serum CA-125 was elevated at 95 U/mL
response.rationale: R4 is strongly supported by the large complex adnexal mass with thick septations and elevated CA-125, which are classic for ovarian cystadenocarcinoma. R5 only cites latent TB, which does not explain the imaging findings. R3 has no raw support and refers to a simple cyst on the right ovary, not the main mass.

rejected.why: No raw support; the simple cyst is on the right ovary, not the main left adnexal mass.
